title: Level 3 (Advanced) - D-26
notes:
West leads the ♥7 against 6♣. At first glance the contract appears to depend strictly upon the spade finesse, but South can make the contract if West has the ♠K as long as he has the ♦A as well. South wins West's heart opening lead and draws 3 rounds of trump.

South then leads the ♦2 through West for a Morton's Fork Coup. If West takes his ♦A, both the ♦Q and ♦K will win tricks allowing South to discard his ♠2. West therefore ducks South's ♦2 and dummy's ♦K wins the trick. South then cashes his hearts, discarding a diamond from dummy on the last round.

South exits with the ♦Q to West's ♦A. West is endplayed into either leading a spade away from his ♠K or leading a diamond to concede a ruff and discard.
